cf8cf717c6471ee73d51ed4c0e85b15b5ed22ebe.tldr: Fail over if primary is unreachable 60+ seconds or replication lag exceeds 5 minutes with saturation.
cf8cf717c6471ee73d51ed4c0e85b15b5ed22ebe.summary: Trigger database failover when the primary server becomes unreachable for more than 60 seconds or when replication lag surpasses 5 minutes while the primary is saturated. Do not initiate failover for isolated slow queries; terminate the problematic query instead.

decisions: Fail over if primary is unreachable for more than 60 seconds.
Fail over if replication lag exceeds 5 minutes with primary saturated.
Do not fail over for a single slow query; kill the query instead.
